newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH AMICA SEES AUGUST/SEPTEMBER BOURSE DEBUT.
newsitem.headline: POLISH AMICA SEES AUGUST/SEPTEMBER BOURSE DEBUT.

text.p: The Polish white appliances maker Amica Wronki SA, the public offer of which was oversubscribed, expects to start trading on the Warsaw Stock Exchange at the turn of August and September, Amica's president said.

"We expect the first listing will be at the turn of August and September and we should not have any problems with fulfilling procedural requirements," Wojciech Kaszynski told a news conference on Wednesday.

He said the company would use funds from the issue of nearly 110 million zlotys to pay back credit taken for the construction of a refrigerator factory and increasing the production capacity of its kitchen-oven factory.
